Name: Dory's Portraits
Author: Dory5116
Description:
All the Bachelors and Bachelorettes done in Dory's style. Some Beach Outfits have been done to some of the characters but not all so apologise. If with furhter demand I should make all the beach outfits I will. Furthermore, all NPC portraits may or may not be added in the future.

[b]How to Install:

Make sure SMAPI and Portraiture is installed

[/b]1. Unzip the file after downloading.

2. There should be a file labelled - "Dory's Portraits"

3. Simply drag and drop the file into:

Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits

4. Run the game then press p during dialogue with characters.

Enjoy!
